 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Anil Verma
 On The 6 th Of November, 2025
 Criminal Appeal No. 208 of 2016
 Santram
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 None for the appellant.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri Rajendra Singh Yadav - PP for the respondent/Stat  ORDER The appellant stood convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366(A) and 376(2) of the IPC read with Section 5/6 of the POCSO Act and sentenced to undergone Seven years RI with fine of Rs.1000/-, Seven years RI with fine of Rs.1000/- and ten years RI with fine of Rs.2000/-
respectively with default stipulations.

As per the status report sent by office of Office Superintendent Distt. Jail Vidisha dated 30.10.2025,
appellant Santram S/o Prabhulal has served the jail sentence of 7 years and seven months and 96 days including the period of remission of two years, four months and 11 days and therefore, he has been released from jail on 01.10.2022.
Today, none appeared on behalf of the appellant which shows that the appellant is not interested to prosecute this appeal.

Looking to the fact that the appellant has served entire jail sentence NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:28207 2 CRA-208-2016 with the remission period, therefore, this appeal has rendered infrcutuous and accordingly, it is dismissed having rendered infructuous.
Let record of the trial court be returned back to the concerned trial court along with a copy of this order.
